draft: In Mexico City, a harmonious community thrives with minimal crime, political strife, and an economy prioritizing well-being. Residents go about their day, attending co-op jobs and swapping goods at the weekly tianguis. Discussions on water allocation occur with neighbors and hydrologists. The city is calm, cooperative, governed gently, environmentally conscious, and socially connected. Conversations focus on neighborhood clean-up days and planting shade trees, while drones monitor traffic and public transit runs on renewables.
